results.title: Privacy Policy | Novix
results.bodyText: Novix Pub Blog Docs Pricing Contact Privacy Policy Last updated: March 26, 2026 Welcome to Novix ("we," "us," or "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our AI-powered scientific research platform at novix.science (the "Service"). Please read this policy carefully. By accessing or using the Service, you agree to the practices described herein. 1. Information We Collect 1.1 Account Information When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and authentication credentials. If you sign in through a third-party provider (e.g., Google, GitHub), we receive basic profile information from that provider. 1.2 Research Data When you use our research tools — including Deep Survey, Idea Spark, Method Design, and other AI-powered features — we collect the queries, prompts, uploaded documents, and any other content you submit to the Service ("Research Data"). 1.3 Usage Data We automatically collect information about how you interact with the Service, including pages visited, features used, timestamps, device type, browser type, IP address, and referring URLs. 1.4 AI Interaction Data We collect data related to your interactions with our AI agents, including conversation logs, generated outputs, and feedback you provide on AI-generated content. This data is used to improve the quality and accuracy of our AI models. 2. How We Use Your Information We use the information we collect to: Provide, maintain, and improve the Service and its AI-powered research tools; Process and respond to your research queries and generate relevant outputs; Personalize your experience and deliver content tailored to your research interests; Improve and train our AI models to enhance accuracy and relevance; Communicate with you about updates, security alerts, and support messages; Monitor and analyze usage trends to improve the Service; Detect, prevent, and address technical issues, fraud, or security concerns. 3. Data Storage and Security We implement industry-standard technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, and regular security assessments. Your data is stored on secure servers. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your information, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. 4. Third-Party Services We may use third-party services for analytics, hosting, payment processing, and other operational purposes. These third parties have access to your information only to perform tasks on our behalf and are obligated to protect it in accordance with this Privacy Policy. The Service may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites, and we encourage you to review their privacy policies. 5. Your Rights Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data. Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data, subject to certain exceptions. Portability: Request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format. Objection: Object to certain processing activities, including direct marketing. Restriction: Request restriction of processing in certain circumstances. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through the "Support" feature available in the Novix app. We will respond to your request within 30 days. 6. AI-Specific Disclosures Our Service uses artificial intelligence to process your research queries and generate outputs. Please be aware of the following: Research inputs you submit may be processed by AI models to generate responses and improve service quality. We may use anonymized and aggregated interaction data to train and improve our AI models. AI-generated content is provided for informational and research purposes only and should not be considered as professional advice. You retain ownership of your original Research Data. AI-generated outputs are subject to our Terms of Service. 7. Data Retention We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. We may also retain certain information as required by law or for legitimate business purposes, such as resolving disputes and enforcing our agreements. When data is no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymize it. 8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage patterns, and deliver personalized content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may affect certain features of the Service. 9. Children's Privacy The Service is not intended for individuals under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 16, we will take steps to delete such information promptly. 10. Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the Service after any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy. 11. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please reach out through the "Support" feature in the Novix app, email us at yasmine_li@novix.science, or contact us via our Discord community. Termination We may suspend or terminate your access to the Service at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice. You may also terminate your account at any time by contacting us. Upon termination, your right to use the Service will immediately cease. Provisions of these Terms that by their nature should survive termination shall remain in effect, including intellectual property, limitation of liability, and indemnification. 10.
